metadata.description: Create images from a description, or use up to 10 reference images to change a scene, combine subjects, or guide its appearance. Edit selected areas with a mask, extend an image with outpainting, and work at resolutions up to 4K. For cutouts or stickers, enable RGBA and request a transparent background; PNG output preserves its alpha channel. Text rendering is moderate: prefer short wording and proofread it; dense infographics are not recommended.
metadata.infos:
**Qwen Image 2.1 (7B)** generates images from text and edits images using up to **10 reference images**. Select reference images in the order you will describe them. Use a control image and a mask for a local edit. For outpainting, select Control Image under Control Image Process (or select a main reference), then enable Spatial Outpainting on Control Image. The same checkbox is available in Image Inpainting. Outpainting replaces red margins with a continuation of the scene. When combined with inpainting, denoising strength applies only to the painted interior. Masked Denoising offers strength controls; LanPaint spends additional time refining masked regions.

For the base model, start with **40 steps**, **guidance 4** and a square image around **1024 pixels**. Resolution categories extend to 4096p, including 4096x4096. Larger images require more memory and time; VAE decoding presets use 1024px tiles for 16GB+, 512px for 8GB+, and 256px for 6GB+, with 25% overlap. Auto chooses by GPU capacity. KV Cache defaults to Disabled to reduce VRAM; enable it for faster denoising when memory permits. The CPU text-embedding cache stays active. The 16-bit VAE setting uses BF16; 32-bit retains the original FP32 precision. Text-rendering quality is moderate: prefer short text and proofread spelling. Dense infographics are not a recommended use. RGBA defaults to Disabled: outputs are RGB and use your selected image format. For transparent cutouts or stickers, set RGBA to Enabled and explicitly request an RGBA image, an alpha channel and a transparent background; WanGP saves RGBA output as PNG to preserve transparency. This uses model-generated alpha, not a background-removal toggle. Prompt enhancement is optional and disabled by default.

NAG controls are temporarily hidden. Use guidance above 1 for standard CFG and negative prompts.

Viggle Turbo profiles use LoRA strength 1 and guidance 1: v0.1 runs 4 steps, v0.2 runs 5, and the recommended v0.2.1 runs 6. Each profile selects the Viggle Turbo scheduler, which applies the matching sigma nodes and disables terminal shift. The built-in Deepy image-generation and editing recipes use the v0.2.1 six-step settings. Viggle calls these adapters previews; complex edits remain weaker than the base model, and masks, RGBA, more than three references and 2K output have not been validated for them.

Pruna v0.1 has separate 5-step and 8-step profiles; 8 steps is the recommended starting point, while 5 steps is faster with lower visual quality. Both use guidance 1, LoRA strength 1, and the Pruna scheduler with the matching sigma nodes and no dynamic or terminal shift. Pruna trained these adapters around 1024x1024 for text-to-image and edits with up to three references; higher resolutions and more references have not been validated. The built-in Deepy Pruna recipes use the recommended 8-step settings.

Use **Qwen Image 2.1 7B LoRAs** in the dedicated LoRA folder. Older Qwen Image/Edit 20B adapters are incompatible even when their filenames use the same convention. Diffusers/PEFT and Kohya naming are supported.
metadata.name: Qwen Image 2.1 TextImage2Image 7B
metadata.prompt_infos:
Describe the finished image, including the subject, composition, lighting and style. Put any exact visible text in quotes. Text-rendering quality is moderate. Prefer short quoted text and proofread spelling and layout; avoid dense infographics.

**Generation:** A red ceramic teapot on a wooden table, soft window light, detailed product photograph.

**Editing:** Change the cat's fur to orange. Keep its pose and the green background unchanged.

**Multiple references:** Put the person from `<image1>` in the jacket from `<image2>`. Keep the person's face and pose. Number references in their selected order.

**Masked editing:** Select the region to replace, then describe what belongs there: Replace the background with a bright blue sky.

**Transparency:** Set RGBA to Enabled, then prompt: This is an RGBA image with transparency. A cartoon dragon sticker. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent. WanGP saves RGBA output as PNG automatically to retain alpha; JPEG cannot store transparency.

Use the negative prompt to describe unwanted content when guidance is above 1. Keep editing instructions specific about both the requested change and details to preserve.

specialities.description: Moderate text-rendering quality, best with short text. Spelling and layout require proofreading; not recommended for dense infographics.
specialities.name: text rendering
